newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends firmer vs dlr, BCE dollar futures drop.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends firmer vs dlr, BCE dollar futures drop.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished firmer against the dollar on Monday, dealers said.
The forint closed at 155.25/30 against the U.S. unit compared with its morning opening of 155.35/40, they said.
"There was little movement all day, as the dollar/mark hardly moved," said Zoltam Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
The forint floats in the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5-percent wide intervention band against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), dollar futures dropped for all but two months and the Ecu rose in three months.
The yen, sterling and Swiss franc finished mixed, while the Italian lira and the German mark were mainly steady.
Yen futures were the most popular, accounting for a quarter of the low total turnover of 2.59 billion forints.
